title: Integration Handshake — Weekly Brief
content:
Attendees: Priya N, Ethan M, Lena F, Marco A, Jesse P, customer PD lead (encrypted)

Purpose: weekly sync to surface integration progress across active onboardings, escalate blockers, and confirm rollout windows. Short-format notes — capture decisions and action owners.

SYNOPSIS
- Overall: 4 active customers in the current wave. Two on track, one degraded latency on p99 after quantized model swap, one blocked on network egress/VPC peering.
- Major decision: For latency regression we will revert to v1.7 quantized profile for Canary until kernel fixes land in runtime (ETA next week).
- Risk: VPC peering approvals taking longer than expected for regulated customer (Lumina Health). Expect 6–10 day delay unless SOC provides interim MSA note.

CUSTOMER UPDATES
1) Meridian Analytics (GA candidate) — status: green/at-risk
   - What happened: Completed Dedicated capacity provisioning; ran first load test (10k rps simulated burst). Observed steady throughput but a 12% p99 latency increase vs baseline during KV cache warmup.
   - Root cause hypothesis: cache warming + excessive batching causing head-of-line buildup under short TTL keys.
   - Mitigation plan: Adjust batch size heuristics (reduce max batch to 6 for this route) and enable prefix cache pre-seed for the top 200 request prefixes. Marco assigned to PR for auto-preseed logic.
   - Action items: Marco -> PR for preseed + limit change (JIRA-INTEG-423), due 2027-04-15. QA smoke on staging by 2027-04-16. 

2) Lumina Health (regulated, private deployment) — status: red
   - Blocker: VPC peering request stalled in infra approvals; customer cannot accept public egress policy. Legal flagged specific KMS BYOK clauses.
   - Notes: Customer wants on-prem package trial but procurement needs PCI/SOC artifacts. Solutions to propose: temporary IP allowlist + TLS-only egress + signed NDA addendum.
   - Decision: escalate to Enterprise AMs and security for a one-off exception path; if not possible, offer week-delayed on-prem pilot.
   - Action items: Priya -> prepare SOC/PCI quick packet and meet legal (Jesse) by 2027-04-14. Jesse -> draft NDA addendum outline by 2027-04-15.

3) Kestrel Commerce (hosted API customer, ramping usage) — status: green
   - Progress: Model swap to 2-bit quantized variant completed; cost per request down ~22%. No functional regressions reported on customer eval prompts.
   - Observations: Small spike in tokenization variance for some international inputs; flagged to RnD for tokenizer normalization check.
   - Action items: Ethan -> follow up with RnD on tokenizer PT (ticket RND-1621) by 2027-04-16.

4) Arcadia Media (dedicated, long-tail generation) — status: yellow
   - Issue: Intermittent traceback from model runtime during peak; stack shows rare kernel OOM when sequence length > 4k for batch sizes >8.
   - Short-term: Implement soft-fallback to smaller batch for requests with long seq length detected. Longer-term: runtime kernel update scheduled in next maintenance window.
   - Action items: Platform eng -> config change for route-level batch adaption (PR queued). Lena -> monitor 48h after change and report.

OPEN BLOCKERS & ESCALATIONS
- VPC peering (Lumina): legal + infra gating. Escalate to TLs in infra and account exec. Potential impact: 2-week slip for private deploy pilot.
- Latency regression after quantization (Meridian): temporary rollback or batch heuristic change required.
- Runtime kernel mem-edge (Arcadia): needs engineering backport; placing as P1 for serving-runtime team.

DECISIONS MADE
- Canary rollback accepted as an interim mitigation for quantization-induced p99 regressions (Meridian).
- Offer NDA addendum and SOC snapshot to Lumina as interim confidence measure.

ACTION ITEMS (owner / due / status)
- Marco Alvarez / 2027-04-15 / in_progress: implement prefix pre-seed + batch cap change (JIRA-INTEG-423).
- Priya Narang / 2027-04-14 / pending: SOC/PCI quick packet + intro to AMs.
- Jesse Park / 2027-04-15 / pending: NDA addendum draft for Lumina.
- Ethan Morales / 2027-04-16 / todo: tokenizer variance follow-up with RnD (RND-1621).
- Lena Fischer / 2027-04-18 / todo: validate Arcadia config change post-deploy.
- Platform Eng (PR #881) / 2027-04-14 / in_review: route-level batching fallback config.

MEETING NOTES / THREADS worth saving
- Slack: #solutions_onboarding thread (see link) — customer screenshots and logs uploaded by fieldeng.
- GH PR: rw-infra PR#881 contains the batching config change; small change to route config template.
- Confluence: integration runbook updates needed — add a section for "quantized rollback checklist" and VPC escalation template.

RISKS & MITIGATION PLANS
- Risk: Multiple customers in wave rely on same quantized kernel path; simultaneous rollback would increase cost temporarily and require coordination.
  - Mitigation: Canary rollbacks per-customer with traffic routing; use smart-routing to shift traffic to hosted fallback variant during maintenance.
- Risk: Legal artifacts timeline slows Lumina onboarding.
  - Mitigation: Provide minimal required artifacts and a temporary IP allowlist to unblock initial testing.

NOTES TO SELF / FRAGMENTS
- need a short one-pager for "How we do a quantized rollback" for AMs — steps + contact matrix.
- consider adding an observable: "batch_size_distribution" to console to detect HL batches quickly.
- check whether KV cache pre-seed introduces warmup cost on cold starts (Marco to simulate).

NEXT SYNC
- Proposal: same time next week 2027-04-19, 0900 PT. If Lumina escalations require more frequent cadence we will add 1:1.

END.
